description:
**Divergence**: the two RFC-mapped sub-type foundation crates of the workspace ship fundamentally different public-API construction patterns.

| Crate | Public `fn new(...)` constructors |
|---|---|
| jscalendar-types | 14 — `NDay::new` (src/lib.rs:424), `RecurrenceRule::new` (:539), `Location::new` (:625), `Link::with_href` (:872), `Link::with_blob_id` (:881), `Participant::new` (:1185), `Alert::new` (:1494), `TimeZoneRule::new` (:1591), `TimeZone::new` (:1736), and 5 more |
| jscontact-types | 0 — `src/lib.rs` has exactly one impl block in non-test code (`impl Serialize for AnniversaryDate` at :1164); zero `pub fn new` exists |

**Policy context**: workspace AGENTS.md section "Public-API construction: deserialize-from-JSON is the canonical path" documents bd:JMAP-sgrr.27 — "the kit deliberately does NOT compensate by adding `fn new(...) -> Self` constructors on every type, and the omission is intentional, not a gap." That policy was decided 2026-05-17 and aligns with the jscontact pattern. jscalendar-types pre-dates the policy and was not retroactively swept.

**Caller-observable cost**: callers of the two crates write fundamentally different code for analogous work. Building a `Participant` uses `Participant::new(roles)`; building a `Phone` requires `serde_json::from_value::<Phone>(json!({...}))`. A future sibling type crate (e.g. RFC-9554 extensions, JSGroup) has two precedents and no signal which is canonical until they happen across the workspace AGENTS.md section.

**Maintainer cost**: every public constructor in jscalendar is API surface that #[non_exhaustive] freezes at the time of authorship; adding a mandatory field to (e.g.) `Participant` requires either a constructor signature change (semver-major) or threading the value through the call sites of `Participant::new`. The deserialize path adapts automatically when the kit adds optional fields.

**Fix**: remove the 14 `pub fn new(...)` constructors from jscalendar-types and update internal callers to use `serde_json::from_value`. Likely surfaces 1-2 internal call sites that depend on the constructor signature; trivial to migrate. Per workspace AGENTS.md the only allowed compensation is `#[doc(hidden)]` test-only constructors, which jscalendar-types does not currently use.

**Cross-reference**: bd:JMAP-sgrr.27 (the workspace policy decision); bd:JMAP-ops7.43 (chat-types Design Constraints table documents the same policy that mail-types and the rest of the type crates are silent on — inverts canonical-template propagation direction).
title: jscalendar-types ships 14 'pub fn new(...)' constructors; jscontact-types ships 0 — workspace policy (bd:JMAP-sgrr.27) aligns with jscontact, making jscalendar the policy outlier
